original.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 adopts a new Kafka Connect health check endpoint (per proposal 89), changing the endpoint used for Kafka Connect health checks; the previous endpoint and any version or configuration conditions are not stated by the evidence.

decision.reason: [ev-da7ff24b2c60] says only that Strimzi 0.46.0 "Adopted new Kafka Connect health check endpoint". That means health checking for Kafka Connect now works differently while the user's configuration stays the same, so behavior-changed fits, and it does not need before/after values. The endpoint is served by Kafka Connect, not by Strimzi itself. That makes protocol-behavior a better family than api-endpoint. The name kafka-connect-health-check-endpoint is kebab-case built only from words in the evidence. Confidence is low because the changelog line does not give the endpoint path or say what the old behavior was.
